authority: NONE. This is analysis and proposal only. It authorises no implementation, no session, no deployment, no external action, no state promotion and no chapter entry. Chapter authorisation, gate declarations and certification closure remain founder-only.

governingRules.R1_STATE_SEPARATION: IMPLEMENTED != VALIDATED != LIVE_CERTIFIED. No gate in this document may be satisfied by the existence of code, a green suite, a merged commit or a completed deploy. Every gate item names the observation that discharges it.
governingRules.R2_NO_TERMINAL_DUMP: There is no end-of-programme validation phase. Every wave candidate terminates in a gate whose evidence is produced by sessions convened INSIDE that wave. Validation that cannot be produced inside a wave is a signal that the wave boundary is wrong, not that the validation should be deferred.
governingRules.R3_CLASS_PRESERVATION: The ten Stage-0 validation classes are preserved verbatim per obligation. A lower-cost class may never silently discharge a higher-cost obligation (Agent E E-SC-12; the F064/F113 case is the worked example).
governingRules.R4_LADDER_NON_IMPLICATION: Architecture / Implementation / Product-Behavior / Cross-System / Real-Boundary / Founder-Product-Acceptance / Item-17 are seven layers. A lower layer passing never implies a higher one (PB-10). No chapter may claim Real-Boundary or Item 17 locally.
governingRules.R5_CONSTRUCTION_IS_NOT_VALIDATION: Where a validation obligation names a capability that does not exist (VD-041, VD-042, VD-050 and parts of VD-029/VD-076/VD-077), it is carried as a CONSTRUCTION obligation with a validation tail. The VD row remains visible on the validation axis and is NOT counted as dischargeable work in a validation schedule (Agent E E-UV-3).
governingRules.R6_BLOCKED_IS_NOT_PENDING: Obligations blocked on an action no agent may take (VD-005, VD-026, VD-032, VD-052, VD-055, VD-060, VD-061, VD-062) are scheduled as LONG-LEAD items placed at the START of the wave that needs them, never queued alongside runnable proofs (Agent E E-UV-4).
governingRules.R7_OUTCOME_VOCABULARY: Every session leg returns exactly one of: PASS · FAIL · NOT_DISCHARGED_BLOCKED_EXTERNAL · NOT_DISCHARGEABLE_NO_DATA · NOT_ATTEMPTED. 'Not attempted' and 'blocked' are never reported as 'no issues found'.
governingRules.R8_GATE_ENFORCEMENT_PROOF: Every ratchet or gate counts as enforcement only after it is demonstrated to FAIL on a real violation (FD-13 precedent, CH-01 and CH-17 certification requirements).
